title: Dinosaur eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dinosaur body -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="65" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="72" rx="18" ry="10" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M82 65 Q95 55 92 40 Q88 50 80 55 Z" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <!-- Spikes on back -->
  <path d="M42 50 L46 40 L50 50 Z" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <path d="M52 48 L56 38 L60 48 Z" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <path d="M62 50 L66 41 L70 51 Z" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M30 60 Q25 45 28 32 Q32 22 38 28 Q36 40 38 58 Z" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="25" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="27" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="21" r="3" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="21" r="1.5" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Mouth open -->
  <path d="M14 28 Q18 34 24 30" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="2" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Snack (cookie) in mouth -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="31" r="5" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="29" r="1" fill="#795548"/>
  <circle cx="19" cy="32" r="1" fill="#795548"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="33" r="1" fill="#795548"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <rect x="58" y="78" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="92" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="92" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Small arms -->
  <path d="M38 60 Q32 58 30 62" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Crumbs -->
  <circle cx="10" cy="36" r="1.5" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFB74D"/>
</svg>
